scope: B2-X0 harness bridge: enables Constants.ENABLE_TEST_ZONE so the game's built-in debug keybinding goto_test_level (End key, project.godot) can switch from Hideout to TestLevel during automated S2 combat-harness runs. Debug-only surface: no gameplay code path changes. Without this the recovered player can never reach TestLevel and the k5 request-driven harness cannot run; the flag gates a single keybind check inside HideoutLevel.gd _input().

entities.expected_runtime_effect: HideoutLevel.gd treats the goto_test_level key as active and switch_levels('test_level', true, 1) loads TestLevel.tscn

not_proven: S2 in-game run evidence (produced by B2-X0 harness run); the flag itself does not teleport the player
